cards.exampleMeaning: Investors' unease over the weakening peso is deepening.
cards.note: Pormal at pangbalita; hindi ginagamit sa karaniwang kuwentuhan. Iba sa 'takot' na matindi at agad.

cards.meaning: contraction, shrinking (of output or the economy)
cards.example: Ang pag-urong ng sektor ng pagmamanupaktura ay unang naitala mula Abril.
cards.exampleMeaning: The factory sector's contraction is the first recorded since April.
cards.note: Pormal at teknikal; iba sa 'pagbaba' na simpleng pagbagsak ng numero.

cards.example: 假期出行人次固然创下纪录，但消费依然谨慎。
cards.examplePinyin: Jiàqī chūxíng réncì gùrán chuàngxià jìlù, dàn xiāofèi yīrán jǐnshèn.
cards.exampleMeaning: Holiday trips have indeed set a record, but spending is still cautious.
cards.note: 书面语/editorial register. Compare 虽然…但是 (neutral concession): 固然 grants a point as true and then pivots to the writer's real argument.
cards.tiesTo: Golden Week trip records vs cautious spending

cards.example: 庞大的客流并未转化为相应的消费。
cards.examplePinyin: Pángdà de kèliú bìng wèi zhuǎnhuà wéi xiāngyìng de xiāofèi.
cards.exampleMeaning: The huge flow of visitors did not translate into a corresponding level of spending.
cards.note: 书面语 abstract collocation: 客流转化为消费, 流量转化为销量. Contrast 变成 (口语, plain change of state): 转化为 implies a process or funnel.
cards.tiesTo: Golden Week 2.13B trips vs weak per-trip spend
